traits.name: Advanced Grappler
traits.description: The fiend can grapple up to four Medium creatures without causing penalties to its movement or actions. For every two Medium creatures it can grapple one Large creature instead, and for every two Large creatures it can grapple one Gargantuan creature instead.

traits.name: Wild Spirit
traits.description: The first attack or ability check the fiend makes each turn has advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The fiend makes one Bite attack, then if it has a creature grappled it uses its Crush.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage. If the target is no more than one size category larger than the fiend, it is restrained and grappled (escape DC 19).

actions.name: Crush
actions.description: Each creature the fiend is grappling must make a DC 19 Strength saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful save. A creature that rolls a result of 20 on their d20 result escapes the grapple automatically.

actions.name: Venomous Bite
actions.description: The fiend bites one creature it is grappling, forcing it to make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 28 (5d10) poison damage and is poisoned. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success and taking 6 (1d10) poison damage on a failure. A creature who fails this saving throw by 5 points or more is paralyzed as long as they are poisoned.

reactions.name: Poison Coat
reactions.description: When a creature hits the fiend with a weapon attack from within 5 feet of it, poisonous gas and blood escapes its body and, as a reaction, it forces its attacker to make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the attacker takes 11 (3d6) poison damage and is poisoned until the start of their next turn.
